items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: I mean Paul Chambers, Ray Brown back in the day, Milt Hinton, Israel Crosby, Garrison.

ctx.x: Okay, so tell me about that.

I mean I’m one of the few guys, there’s some other guys, but I don’t play with an amp, and I play with gut strings. And I do it, well first of all gut strings are really expensive and they go out of tune and they’re a pain in the ass. But you know all my favorite bass players, and all everybody else’s favorite bass players for the most part played like that. I mean Paul Chambers, Ray Brown back in the day, Milt Hinton, Israel Crosby, Garrison. And look man, I get it. The bass is hard to play and it’s quiet. You…
